title: HMRC email updates, videos and webinars for employing people
text:
Subscribe to receive email updates

 Subscribe to the HMRC help and support email service to get information on a wide range of topics for individuals, businesses, employers and agents.

 You can also:

 • make changes to your topic subscriptions

 • unsubscribe from the service whenever you want to

 Registering and joining webinars

 You can register for webinars in advance but we recommend you join each webinar 5 minutes before the start.

 Getting started as an employer

 Watch a collection of videos to find out what to do if you’re a new employer.

 Help for new employers .

 You will find out about:

 • using payroll software to send reports

 • 
 PAYE Settlement Agreements ( PSAs )

 • paying PAYE 

 • the help you can get if you cannot pay your tax bill

 • adding a tax to your business tax account

 Understanding tax codes

 Watch a collection of videos about understanding tax codes.

 Understanding your tax code .

 You will find out:

 • what a tax code is

 • how a tax code works

 • what an emergency tax code is

 • what changes can affect tax codes

 • how changes to tax codes affect pay

 • how to update details online if a tax code is wrong

 • about starting a new job without a P45

 Running a small business

 Watch a collection of videos to find out more about running a small business.

 Running a small business .

 You will find out about:

 • Corporation Tax and what it is

 • how to deal with your first Corporation Tax account

 • how to pay your Self Assessment tax bill

 • paying your Corporation Tax bill

 • when and how to pay PAYE 

 • HMRC support if you’re unable to pay a tax debt

 • which structure to choose when registering your business

 • basic recording keeping

 How to add a tax through your business tax account

 Watch a video to find out about how to add a tax through your business tax account.

 How do I add a tax to my business tax account? 

 You will find out how to add the 4 main tax services to your business tax account:

 • Corporation Tax

 • Self Assessment

 • 
 PAYE for Employers

 • VAT

 Sign in to your HMRC business tax account to view your tax position and manage all your taxes from one place.

 Help your employees with their National Insurance number

 Watch a video on how to store your National Insurance number to your Apple or Google wallet.

 How to store your National Insurance number to your Apple or Google wallet .

 You will find out how to:

 • add your National Insurance number to your Apple or Google wallet

 • use the HMRC app or your online account

 Employer filing obligations

 Live webinar

 Register for the next live webinar about employer filing obligations .

 You will learn about:

 • why employers need to send regular reports

 • why, when and how to send a Full Payment Submission ( FPS ) and an Employer Payment Summary ( EPS )

 • exceptions

 • key dates

 • payments after leaving

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a  recorded webinar about employer filing obligations .

 Payroll

 Submitting forms P11D and P11D(b) online

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a  recorded webinar about submitting forms P11D and P11D(b) online .

 Employers — what’s new for 2026 to 2027

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about what’s new for 2026 to 2027 .

 You will learn about:

 • Income Tax

 • National Insurance contributions and Employment Allowance

 • expenses and benefits for employees

 • National Living Wage and National Minimum Wage

 • statutory payments

 • student loans

 Annual reports and tasks

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about payroll — annual reports and tasks .

 You will learn about:

 • the steps you need to take at the end of the tax year

 • how to set up payroll records for the new tax year

 • sending your last Full Payment Submission

 • confirming your final submission

 • updating your software for the new tax year

 • issuing P60s

 • entering tax codes for the new tax year

 Getting payroll information right

 Live webinar

 Register for the next live webinar about getting payroll information right .

 You will learn about:

 • how to provide accurate information on payroll reports

 • why, when and how to send  FPS  and  EPS  reports to HMRC

 • what you can reclaim on an  EPS 

 • common mistakes in payroll information and how to avoid them

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about getting payroll information right .

 Expenses and benefits

 Company cars, vans and fuel

 Live webinar

 Register for the next  live webinar about company cars, vans and fuel .

 This webinar is for employers whose employees and directors have private use of a company car or van. You will learn about:

 • tax and National Insurance

 • the details you need to keep about the car or van

 • fuel you make available for private use

 The first part of the webinar covers company cars and the second part covers company vans.

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about company cars, vans and fuel .

 Employees with more than one workplace

 Live webinar

 Register for the next live webinar about if your employees have more than one workplace .

 You will learn about:

 • employee travel to different types of workplace, such as a temporary workplace

 • the different types of worker

 • geographical locations

 • the 24 month rule

 • the 40% test

 • the effect multiple workplaces have on tax and National Insurance

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar if your employees have more than one workplace .

 Employee travel

 Live webinar

 Register for the next live webinar about employee travel .

 You will learn about:

 • reimbursing employees undertaking travel on behalf of the employer

 • an overview of the tax treatment of:

 • travel and subsistence payments to employees

 • mileage payments for employees using their own vehicle

 • scale rate payments

 • the records you need to keep and when they need to be reported

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about employee travel .

 Phones, internet and homeworking

 Live webinar

 Register for the next live webinar about phones, internet and homeworking .

 You will learn about tax and National Insurance where an employer provides:

 • a mobile phone or reimburses the use of a personal mobile phone

 • broadband in an employee’s home, or pays towards it homeworking expenses to its employees

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about phones, internet and homeworking .

 Trivial benefits

 Live webinar

 Register for the next live webinar about trivial benefits .

 This webinar for employers gives an overview of trivial benefits. You will learn about:

 • what trivial benefits are

 • what conditions have to be met to be exempt from reporting to HMRC

 • examples of trivial benefits scenarios

 • what your responsibilities are

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about trivial benefits .

 Social functions and parties

 Live webinar

 Register for the next  live webinar about social functions and parties .

 You will learn about the tax and National Insurance treatment of providing employees with annual social functions, including:

 • the conditions for the event to be exempt from tax and National Insurance and reporting

 • 
 PAYE  settlement agreements and how to apply

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about social functions and parties .

 Statutory pay

 Statutory Sick Pay

 Live webinar

 Register for the next  live webinar about Statutory Sick Pay .

 You will learn about:

 • qualifying conditions

 • paying Statutory Sick Pay

 • company sick pay

 • holidays and bank holidays

 • agency, casual and term-time workers

 • not being entitled to Statutory Sick Pay

 • keeping records

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about Statutory Sick Pay .

 Statutory Maternity and Paternity Pay

 Live webinar

 Register for the next  live webinar about Statutory Maternity and Paternity Pay .

 You will learn about:

 • who qualifies for these statutory payments

 • how much to pay using the GOV.UK calculator

 • how to claim back these statutory payments

 • keeping in touch days

 • the records you need to keep

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about Statutory Maternity and Paternity Pay .

 PAYE Settlement Agreements

 Watch a collection of videos about PAYE Settlement Agreements ( PSAs ).

 PAYE Settlement Agreements ( PSAs ) .

 You will find out about:

 • what a PAYE Settlement Agreement is

 • how to apply for a PAYE Settlement Agreement

 • how you submit a PAYE Settlement Agreement calculation online

 • how you pay a PAYE Settlement Agreement

 • what help you can get if you cannot pay your tax bill

 Fraud in the private security industry supply chain

 Watch a video about fraud in the private industry supply chain.

 What is Private Security Industry supply-chain fraud? 

 You will find out:

 • what supply chain fraud is

 • why security workers must be treated as employees for tax purposes

 • what the financial and legal risks are

 • the essential checks all security suppliers should make

 • how complying with PAYE protects both workers and employers

 Fraud in the labour supply chain

 Watch a collection of videos about fraud in the labour supply chain.

 Fraud in the labour supply chain .

 You will find out:

 • what is outsourced labour payroll fraud

 • what mini umbrella company fraud is

 • what labour fraud in the construction industry is

 Labour supply chain due diligence for local authorities

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a  recorded webinar about due diligence in the supply chain for local authorities .

 You will find out about:

 • new supply chain due diligence principles

 • examples of good due diligence

 • the most serious fraud in the public sector

 Responsibilities when your business grows

 Risks for agencies and other businesses working with umbrella companies operating avoidance schemes

 Watch a collection of videos about the risks for agencies and businesses who use the services of umbrella companies in their supply chains.

 Tax avoidance schemes — risks 

 You find out about:

 • umbrella companies promoting tax avoidance schemes

 • the risks to contractors

 Paying your Corporation Tax bill

 Watch a video about paying your Corporation Tax bill.

 How do I pay my Corporation Tax bill? .

 You will find out about:

 • key deadlines

 • how to find your payment reference

 • ways to pay online

 Mini umbrella company fraud

 Watch a video about the risks of using mini umbrella companies in your supply chain.

 What is mini umbrella company fraud? .

 You will find out about:

 • what mini umbrella company fraud is

 • the risks of using mini umbrella companies

 • the impact of mini umbrella company fraud

 • the signs of mini umbrella company fraud

 • what to do if you suspect supply chain fraud

 What the Informants Scheme is when reporting tax fraud or avoidance

 Watch a  recorded webinar about the Informants Scheme is when reporting tax fraud or avoidance .

 You will find out about:

 • what the Informants Scheme is

 • who might make a report

 • what information you’ll need to provide

 • what happens after making a report

 • the confidentiality of the information you provide
changeNote: Live webinars for 'Employees with more than one workplace', 'Employee travel', 'Phones, internet and homeworking' and 'Trivial benefits' have been added. The webinar links for 'Company cars, vans and fuel' and 'Labour supply chain due diligence for local authorities' have been updated.
